name: @knf/notifyengine
description: Headless push-notification engine for React Native / Expo — a permission state machine, a token-to-backend lifecycle with dedupe and rotation, a declarative Android channel registry, tap-to-route intents, per-feature preferences and a data-driven foreground policy, behind injectable transport/device/storage seams. Bring your own backend adapter; ships fakes and a transport conformance suite.
